results.title: Service Annual Survey Methodology - Census Bureau
results.content: The U.S. Census Bureau conducted the Service Annual Survey (SAS) to provide national estimates of annual revenues and expenses of establishments classified in select service sectors. The estimates were developed using data from a probability sample of firms located in the United States that have paid employees (i.e., employer firms). Total estimates are computed using the Horvitz-Thompson estimator, i.e. the sum of weighted reported or imputed data, for all selected sampling units that meet the sample canvass and tabulation criteria. For the linking operation to occur, for the 2016 Service Annual Survey, two years of data were collected (2015 and 2016) from units in the new sample. The **Total Quantity Response Rate (TQRR)** is defined as the percentage of the estimated (weighted) total of a given data item reported by the active tabulation units in the statistical period or from sources determined to be equivalent-quality-to-reported data.
